results.criterion: The page title and header show the name Brew Lab and mention Indiranagar, Bengaluru
results.note: <title> is 'Brew Lab | Cafe in Indiranagar, Bengaluru'; the hero eyebrow and h1 carry both, but the <header> element holds only the 'Brew Lab' brand link and nav.

results.criterion: A menu section lists items grouped by category, each with a name and a price in ₹; any price not supplied is visibly marked as a placeholder
results.note: 3 category cards (Hot Coffee, Cold Coffee, Bites), 9 items, each name and '₹ price' wrapped in span.ph, plus a .notice banner; the lede says prices are in rupees.

results.criterion: An opening hours section states 8am to 10pm for every day of the week
results.note: table.hours has 7 rows, Monday to Sunday, each reading '8am to 10pm'; the lede and footer repeat it.

results.criterion: A location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and includes a map link or embed; the street address is visibly marked as a placeholder until supplied
results.note: h2 'Find us in Indiranagar, Bengaluru'; Google Maps link and iframe embed present (both listed in external_resources); street address is span.ph 'Street address to be added'.

results.criterion: A pre-order form lets a visitor choose coffee items and quantities, enter a name and a pickup time, see a running total, and submit
results.note: 6 item rows with stepper and number inputs, #pre-name, #pre-time, output#total updated on click/input/change, submit handler validates and shows a request-only message. The pickup-request wording satisfies the charter rule against claiming confirmation or payment.

results.criterion: The file has a viewport meta tag, its base CSS targets small screens, and it uses min-width media queries for larger screens
results.note: Viewport meta present; base grids are single-column; only @media (min-width: 640px) and (min-width: 960px) are used, with no max-width queries.

results.criterion: The layout has no horizontal scrolling at 360px width
results.note: Mechanical check: phone width 360, overflow_px 0; desktop 1280, overflow_px 0.

results.criterion: The site is a single HTML file with no build step and no local file dependencies
results.note: 24,341 bytes, inline <style> and <script>; the only external resources are two google.com/maps URLs; no local src or href files.

results.criterion: Every placeholder is visibly marked so it can be told apart from real content
results.note: span.ph (dashed yellow box, 'PLACEHOLDER:' prefix) covers item names, prices, sample order prices, address, phone, map pin note and pickup rules; the category names (Hot Coffee, Cold Coffee, Bites) are invented but unmarked, though a .notice banner says the menu is a placeholder.
